name: Kurisu Taketoshi
source:
An ordinary white-collar worker by day, by night he accepts commissions from customers he has verified as trustworthy to sexually violate specific female targets.

In addition to his physical strength, his suit is equipped with protection to his genitals and other vital points to eliminate the risk of injury at the hands of his targets.
